actions.confirm_identity_authority: Confirm identity and authority from evidence, or propose the identification check needed
actions.check_record: Propose checking a specific bank record: journal, register, log or system
actions.ask_customer: Ask the customer for one specific missing piece of information
actions.request_confirmation: Send a proposed change for the customer's or administrator's secure confirmation
actions.request_team_action: Ask a bank team to register, block, generate, revoke or review something
actions.route_to_secure_process: Direct the customer to a secure self-service or recovery process
actions.refer_specialist: Refer to a specialist team: bereavement, financial difficulty, specialist support, complaints
actions.hold_or_decline: Hold a payment or change, or decline a disclosure or action, with the reason
actions.escalate_urgent: Escalate urgently to fraud, security or crisis-trained colleagues
actions.signpost: Give external support details: crisis lines, free debt advice, ombudsman, interpreter
actions.reply_to_customer: Reply with the recorded status and what it does not confirm
